title: Mindfulness-based interventions for sleep disturbances, physical symptoms, and biological outcomes in women with cancer: a scoping review.
publicationName: Journal of psychosomatic obstetrics and gynaecology
journalName: Journal of psychosomatic obstetrics and gynaecology
snippet: Insomnia is prevalent among women with cancer and often co-occurs with fatigue, pain, and physiological dysregulation, yet these domains are rarely examined together in mindfulness-based intervention (MBI) research.
